The ETB black market rate is currently 180.51 ETB/USD, representing a 15.7% premium over the official rate of 156.04 ETB. Strong selling pressure indicates USDT supply increase.
📊 Why the 15.7% Gap Between Black Market & Official Rate?
The 15.7% gap exists primarily due to foreign currency shortage in official banking channels, forcing businesses to seek USD through parallel markets at premium rates.
🔴 Black Market Drivers
  • High demand for USD from importers and businesses
  • Limited forex availability through official channels
  • Diaspora remittance preferences for better rates
🏛️ Official Rate Factors
  • NBE monetary policy and forex reserves
  • IMF program requirements and reform timeline
